fusions.name: Far Pounce
fusions.desc: A leaping kick at a target up to 6 tiles away, at or below 25% health. It deals 20 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Soundless Landing
fusions.desc: You bound up to 6 tiles to the target and land on all four hooves, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Unheard Bound
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Still on Four Feet
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
